coverage.laneCounts: All 8^4 = 4,096 labeled E/S/W/N combinations of 0–2 entry lanes and 0–2 exit lanes, excluding a 0/0 leg. Automatic circulating lanes stay within 1–2.
coverage.movements: All 16^2 = 256 destination-subset pairs for one two-lane entry, repeated at E/S/W/N: 1,024 cases. Other approaches retain two-lane defaults.
coverage.review: Saved reports; all subsets of spiral entries and gore locations; lane widths; gore widths; medians; diameters; speeds; skew; 2/3/5/6 legs; oval/peanut shapes; attached roads; custom markings; 3/4-lane stress cases.
coverage.limits: Continuous angles, dimensions and arbitrary numbers of approaches have no finite exhaustive set. This is not the Cartesian product of every setting or every destination choice on all eight entry lanes simultaneously (16^8 = 4,294,967,296 assignments). Out-of-range and conflicting cases are intentionally retained.
